extractive.retention: verbatim: every expected answer appears in the output (grading.answered against the output text)

abstractive.retention: qa: the QA reader answers each question 3 times; a question counts as lost only when at least 2 of the 3 replies miss

not_applicable: a candidate whose output equals its input byte for byte did not run on that payload (under its minimum); the row is reported as n/a, not as a score of 0

timing.shipped_rules: ICompressionPipeline.CompressAsync wall time inside the .NET process, after one warm-up call per payload
timing.kompress_int8: tokenize + ONNX run + decode inside the Python process, model loaded beforehand
timing.rtk_ccr: HTTP round trip through a private rtk-proxy (ccr on) minus the median round trip through a second private rtk-proxy with --ccr false, same fake upstream

output_counted: compression counts every character the model would see, including rtk's preview wrapper and marker

amendments.invocation: pi -p with --no-tools --no-session --no-context-files --no-extensions --no-skills --no-prompt-templates --no-mcp, proxy variables cleared so the call does not pass through ai-proxy

timing.haiku_digest: pi process wall time, stand-in: not Haiku's latency

amendments.digest_is_stand_in: retention and compression are reported; the digest's latency and score are labelled stand-in and do not settle digest-verdict
amendments.reader_calls: each reader call answers all of a payload's questions as a JSON array, in order; a reply that is not an array of the right length answers every question with nothing (a miss), and the raw reply is kept
amendments.thinking: reader at low effort; digest and summarizer with thinking off
amendments.identity_runs: identity's output is the payload itself, so its 3 runs differ only in the reader's replies

amendments.after: the first full run of all six candidates had been seen; nothing already scored is re-scored
